notes: Ludum Dare 55 Unity game Oversummoned by Kettle Game Studio (https://kettle-studio.itch.io/oversummoned; https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/55/oversummoned-1). Guide demons to matching summoners via pentagrams, with upgrade houses and healing cauldrons. Complete Unity 2022.3.24f1 project (changeset 334eb2a0b267) with playable scenes Assets/Prefabs/Scenes/MainMenu.unity, Level1.unity–Level6.unity, and EndMenu.unity enabled in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2024 Kettle Game Studio). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): 2D Sprite 1.0.0, TextMesh Pro 3.0.6, Timeline 1.7.6, uGUI 1.0.0, Visual Scripting 1.9.2, test framework, IDE packages (Rider / Visual Studio / VS Code), Collab Proxy, Linux toolchain, and built-in modules. LiberationSans (SIL Open Font License 1.1, designer Steve Matteson) is the bundled TextMesh Pro default font; LiberationSans - OFL.txt is retained. TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset and the TextMesh Pro User Guide 2016.pdf were omitted; TMP Settings.asset m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared and m_enableEmojiSupport was set to 0; the playable scenes do not require them. Unused Unity template scene Assets/Prefabs/Scenes/SampleScene.unity (not in EditorBuildSettings) was omitted. Third-party fonts were omitted because they are not whitelist-redistributable OSS (scene/GUID references and materials may remain): Angel rhapsody.ttf (md5 426858ed04a545dda02248f8c4ca1d9d; name table Copyright 2020 Stringlabs, All rights reserved; personal-use / commercial license required) plus Angel rhapsody SDF.asset and Angel rhapsody Outline.asset; BRIDGE.TTF (md5 182bfb90d177a5a093bdc690c31aff35; name table family Bridgnorth, copyright Brignorth Regular (C) Copyright PJL '96, no SPDX) plus BRIDGE SDF.asset; FenwickWoodtype.ttf (md5 5b17c637fa4b7c1f50527eae2d24f80a; name table Copyright (c) Typographer Mediengestaltung, 2001. All rights reserved) plus FenwickWoodtype SDF.asset. Soundtrack and SFX under Assets/Sound/ (including DemonWaltz.mp3, also offered as a download on the itch page) are credited to team member Sergey Duyunov and included under the repository MIT. 2D sprites, 3D/Krita sources (Demons/, concept_1.kra), and painted material atlases (cauldron.png, house1_tex.png, house2_tex.png) are retained as team art (itch credits Oleg Arutyunov with 2D art and code, Nicole Akopdzhanova with 3D art). No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no Library/Logs/DLL, no .DS_Store, no LFS. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~38M snapshot after omissions. Claim #4126. Team also: Viacheslav Ivanchenko (code, QA & mental support).
